variants.subject: Florida government contracting
variants.body:
Hi,

We help businesses turn government registrations and capabilities into a practical sales plan — target agencies, opportunities, vehicles, and capture steps.

We're expanding our Florida state/local program and identified your company as a possible fit. Would a 15-minute review of where you may have realistic public-sector opportunities be useful?

Kevin
Pathways 2 Government Contracting

variants.subject: Re: Florida government contracting
variants.body: Following up in case Florida state/local contracting is on your growth list. We can quickly show which agencies and opportunity types line up with your capabilities and where the gaps are. Worth a short conversation?

variants.subject: Worth mapping the Florida market?
variants.body: Many firms are registered but still do not have a clear agency and opportunity path. Our work is focused on turning that into an actionable pursuit plan. Open to a quick review?

variants.subject: Close the loop?
variants.body: I'll close the loop for now. If Florida state/local government growth becomes a priority, reply Florida and I'll send a few times to talk.
